scope.closed_world: The 24 source Lua paths in trait-deep-audit/campaign/source_inventory.json under UT_CORE plus their UT_CORE 42.0 release counterparts, all 151 UniversalTraits source Lua callers, relevant UniversalTraits trait-definition exclusivity, current svn-964 PZ Java/Lua producer and receiver evidence, current tests/mocks, MASTER_COVERAGE_LEDGER.md, and recurring_pattern_findings.json.
scope.write_boundary: Only this artifact was authorized for modification; no source, release/live copy, PZCodebase, accepted artifact, tool/test, document, skill, Git, deployment, or game state was changed.

live_munch_evidence.freshness: All 24 target source mtimes precede the UTMods index; current source hashes were independently read from disk.

verified_prior_findings.title: Weapon-hit consumers bind target and weapon in the wrong positions
verified_prior_findings.reproduction_or_source_evidence: Current producer emits (wielder,target,weapon,damageSplit), while both handlers declare (attacker,weapon,target); the player target is misbound and the guards return.
verified_prior_findings.missing_proof: Current-build in-game Kahlua observation remains unrun.
verified_prior_findings.recommended_correction: Bind (attacker,target,weapon,damageSplit) and update mocks from the producer contract.
verified_prior_findings.smallest_regression_test: Fire the real four-argument order and assert both consumers reach the player branch.
verified_prior_findings.resolution_evidence: Commit 2f98749 corrected the producer argument order and elapsed-time cooldown. Current tests fire the exact producer order and advance world time without synthetic hits.

verified_prior_findings.title: Fracture cooldown counts later hits instead of elapsed time
verified_prior_findings.reproduction_or_source_evidence: UT_fractureCooldown is decremented only inside the weapon-hit callback; 300 therefore means 300 subsequent hits.
verified_prior_findings.missing_proof: Current-build in-game Kahlua observation remains unrun.
verified_prior_findings.recommended_correction: Store a world-age expiry or decrement from a time/tick producer.
verified_prior_findings.smallest_regression_test: Set the cooldown, advance the intended duration without hits, then assert the next eligible hit may roll.
verified_prior_findings.resolution_evidence: Commit 2f98749 corrected the producer argument order and elapsed-time cooldown. Current tests fire the exact producer order and advance world time without synthetic hits.

verified_prior_findings.title: Heavy-handler staggering does not enforce its one-per-tick guarantee
verified_prior_findings.reproduction_or_source_evidence: Offsets are derived from the minimum throttle, but each handler is tested against its own throttle; mixed 30/60 schedules can coincide and throttle 0 would run every tick.
verified_prior_findings.missing_proof: No live performance trace was authorized.
verified_prior_findings.recommended_correction: Use a single heavy work queue/token or weaken the stated guarantee and budget for collisions.
verified_prior_findings.smallest_regression_test: Simulate the LCM window for the current four heavy handlers and assert at most one execution per tick.

verified_prior_findings.title: Vehicle traits subscribe to two nonexistent engine events
verified_prior_findings.reproduction_or_source_evidence: The registry contains OnEnterVehicle, not OnVehicleEnter; BaseVehicle triggers it with only player and only in its client branch. No OnVehicleExit/OnExitVehicle producer exists in the current registry or BaseVehicle.exit path.
verified_prior_findings.missing_proof: A supported exit lifecycle must be selected and proven in game.
verified_prior_findings.recommended_correction: Use OnEnterVehicle(player) for entry and a verified poll/lifecycle hook for exit restoration; test load-while-driving too.
verified_prior_findings.smallest_regression_test: Build Events from the engine registry, enter then exit a vehicle, and assert apply once plus exact restore.

verified_prior_findings.title: All 24 UT_CORE source Lua files match their 42.0 release copies byte-for-byte
verified_prior_findings.reproduction_or_source_evidence: Each source SHA-256 equals the corresponding release SHA-256; there are no missing or extra scoped release Lua files.
verified_prior_findings.missing_proof: Live deployment parity was outside scope and was not inferred.
verified_prior_findings.recommended_correction: Keep package parity as a deterministic read-only gate.
verified_prior_findings.smallest_regression_test: Recompute the 24 source/release hashes and require exact set and byte equality.

rejected_prior_findings.title: F-CORE-001's proposed argument-order correction is insufficient for DamageMultHook
rejected_prior_findings.reproduction_or_source_evidence: The producer fires before processHitDamage. Even with target bound correctly, current health has not fallen, so curHealth >= prevHealth and the hook returns.
rejected_prior_findings.missing_proof: No complete source-faithful resolved-damage signal exists in the inspected Build 42 producer surface; user direction remains required.
rejected_prior_findings.recommended_correction: Retain the signature fix but defer measurement until after native damage, carrying a bounded pending-hit record.
rejected_prior_findings.smallest_regression_test: With correct event order, fire pre-damage event, apply native loss, run the deferred hook, and assert exactly multiplier-adjusted total loss.
rejected_prior_findings.resolution_evidence: The hook no longer consumes OnWeaponHitCharacter. Aggregate overall body-health deltas drive one bounded extra reduction with hostile receiver, static member lookup/invocation, core-registration lookup/invocation, and delayed recalculation coverage, but same-update healing remains indistinguishable.

rejected_prior_findings.title: The recurring vehicle recommendation cannot be satisfied by simply renaming both events
rejected_prior_findings.reproduction_or_source_evidence: OnEnterVehicle exists, but the current registry and exit implementation expose no paired vehicle-exit Lua event.
rejected_prior_findings.missing_proof: The correct supported exit/reset observation point remains unproven.
rejected_prior_findings.recommended_correction: Use the real entry event plus an explicitly verified exit detector; do not invent OnExitVehicle.
rejected_prior_findings.smallest_regression_test: Exercise ordinary entry, seat change, exit, load in vehicle, and vehicle removal with baseline restoration assertions.

omissions.title: Damage multiplier observes health before native weapon damage
omissions.reproduction_or_source_evidence: OnWeaponHitCharacter precedes processHitDamage; current handler requires curHealth < prevHealth during that callback.
omissions.missing_proof: No complete source-faithful resolved-damage signal exists in the inspected Build 42 producer surface; user direction remains required.
omissions.recommended_correction: Capture a pending hit at the producer and reconcile after native damage on the next verified update.
omissions.smallest_regression_test: Start at 100 health, fire the event before native 10 damage, then reconcile once and assert the configured total loss.
omissions.resolution_evidence: The hook no longer consumes OnWeaponHitCharacter. Aggregate overall body-health deltas drive one bounded extra reduction with hostile receiver, static member lookup/invocation, core-registration lookup/invocation, and delayed recalculation coverage, but same-update healing remains indistinguishable.

omissions.title: Positive XP corrections recursively re-enter AddXP
omissions.reproduction_or_source_evidence: The five-argument AddXP overload ignores callLua and always emits AddXP after mutation. The mocks only log nested AddXP, so they suppress the recursive producer. A 1.5 multiplier geometrically adds further positive corrections.
omissions.missing_proof: Exact engine behavior at XP maximum and stack-depth failure was not executed.
omissions.recommended_correction: Add an explicit re-entry guard scoped by player/perk/correction, or use a non-emitting verified XP mutation path.
omissions.smallest_regression_test: Make mock AddXP emit Events.AddXP; original +100 at 1.5 must finish at exactly +150 with one correction.

omissions.title: Spawn helpers call three nonexistent or case-wrong BodyPart methods
omissions.reproduction_or_source_evidence: Current BodyPart exposes SetHealth (capital S), generateFracture/setFractureTime, and setBurned/setBurnTime; it does not expose setHealth, setFractured, or setBurnDamage. Permissive mocks hide all three. UT_burned also requests three injury parts but the burn loop targets every body part.
omissions.missing_proof: The corrected severity/time mapping requires design confirmation and in-game proof.
omissions.recommended_correction: Use exact current receiver methods and explicit health/fracture/burn units; scope burns to the caller's intended parts.
omissions.smallest_regression_test: Run strict receiver mocks derived from current Java; each of the four traits must complete OnNewGame and affect only declared body parts.

omissions.title: Generic one-handed and two-handed traits miss recognized weapon families
omissions.reproduction_or_source_evidence: classifyWeapon returns axe/spear/blade/blunt before testing isTwoHandWeapon; generic handedness entries are keyed as twohanded/onehanded and therefore never match recognized family weapons.
omissions.missing_proof: Representative live weapon metadata was not executed.
omissions.recommended_correction: Evaluate handedness entries independently from family entries, or permit multiple categories per weapon.
omissions.smallest_regression_test: Give UT_twohanded a two-handed axe and UT_onehanded a one-handed blade; both must apply their delay rule.

omissions.title: Zombie collision callback membership survives a player or trait change
omissions.reproduction_or_source_evidence: OnCreatePlayer only adds declared callbacks for traits present; it never removes callbacks for traits absent. The dispatch loop does not recheck trait ownership.
omissions.missing_proof: Cross-character process reuse was not executed in game.
omissions.recommended_correction: Rebuild callback membership exactly on player creation and recheck ownership before dispatch.
omissions.smallest_regression_test: Create player A with batteringram, then player B without it in the same Lua state; B must not invoke the callback.

omissions.title: XP cap enforcement permits a below-cap award to cross the cap
omissions.reproduction_or_source_evidence: The hook cancels only when currentLevel >= hardCap; it does not clamp an award that begins below the cap but crosses one or more levels.
omissions.missing_proof: Exact XP thresholds per affected perk were not scenario-tested.
omissions.recommended_correction: Compare old/new XP against the hard-cap threshold and reverse only the excess.
omissions.smallest_regression_test: Place the player one XP below the cap, award enough for two levels, and assert final XP equals the cap threshold.

omissions.title: Direct scalar modifier APIs overwrite legal coexisting trait effects
omissions.reproduction_or_source_evidence: These APIs store one scalar per effect/perk without source buckets. Script MET permits staunch with every bleed trait, anemic with heavy/weak bleed, and antigun/luddite with mundane; load order decides the surviving value.
omissions.missing_proof: Desired additive versus multiplicative composition is not documented.
omissions.recommended_correction: Accept sourceId and aggregate deterministically, or make every overlapping trait pair mutually exclusive.
omissions.smallest_regression_test: Apply each legal pair in both orders and assert identical intended aggregate values.

omissions.title: Two UniversalTraits caller families target UTCore APIs that do not exist
omissions.reproduction_or_source_evidence: All 71 UTCore function exports were enumerated; neither helper exists. Both callers guard the call, so the intended effect silently disappears rather than failing.
omissions.missing_proof: The intended timed-action family coverage for medical/mechanics actions is unspecified.
omissions.recommended_correction: Implement verified helper families or remove/rewrite the guarded calls and descriptions.
omissions.smallest_regression_test: Load each trait with representative current timed actions and assert an observable duration change.

omissions.title: SpeedHook prints an unconditional diagnostic on every movement event during actions
omissions.reproduction_or_source_evidence: When a nonzero speed modifier and any character action are present, OnPlayerMove prints [UT_ADIAG] for every event without a debug gate or throttle.
omissions.missing_proof: Log volume and frame impact were not profiled in game.
omissions.recommended_correction: Remove the print or route it through a disabled-by-default bounded diagnostic.
omissions.smallest_regression_test: Simulate 600 movement events during one action and assert zero output with diagnostics disabled.

omissions.title: Inventory capacity increases are never restored when carry targets fall
omissions.reproduction_or_source_evidence: reconcileAggregatedModifiers writes inventory capacity only when targetCap > current; a later lower target updates maxWeightBase but leaves inventory capacity elevated.
omissions.missing_proof: Dynamic modifier removal was not exercised in game.
omissions.recommended_correction: Cache a trustworthy baseline and reconcile both upward and downward without clobbering external owners.
omissions.smallest_regression_test: Raise capacity with a source bucket, remove/lower that bucket, reconcile, and assert both player base and inventory capacity return.

cross_file_findings.title: Trait cache and active tick arrays assume traits never change after OnCreatePlayer
cross_file_findings.reproduction_or_source_evidence: The cache invalidates and active handlers rebuild on player creation; no current producer handles later CharacterTrait mutation.
cross_file_findings.missing_proof: Whether this mod permits runtime trait mutation in supported play is not established.
cross_file_findings.recommended_correction: Either document immutability as a hard contract or subscribe to a verified mutation signal and rebuild exactly.
cross_file_findings.smallest_regression_test: Add and remove a trait after creation, then assert hasTrait and active handler membership change immediately.

cross_file_findings.title: Core and tick handler registration is not reload-idempotent
cross_file_findings.reproduction_or_source_evidence: Both registration functions append without identity replacement; the central event is also added unconditionally. A partial Lua reload could duplicate work.
cross_file_findings.missing_proof: Current ResetLua global/event lifecycle was not reproduced.
cross_file_findings.recommended_correction: Make registrations keyed/idempotent and fence central event attachment with a reload-safe owner token.
cross_file_findings.smallest_regression_test: Load the module twice into one event table and assert one central event plus one entry per identity.

cross_file_findings.title: registerPeriodicHandler does not reject an unavailable event name
cross_file_findings.reproduction_or_source_evidence: The function dereferences Events[intervalEvent].Add when Events exists; a misspelled or removed event produces a nil receiver. Current 12 callers use known names, so this is a public-surface gap rather than a current failure.
cross_file_findings.recommended_correction: Validate event membership and return a deterministic error before mutation.
cross_file_findings.smallest_regression_test: Register with a nonexistent event and assert no handler state or event table changes.

cross_file_findings.title: Vehicle baseline restore may clobber modifications applied after UTCore's snapshot
cross_file_findings.reproduction_or_source_evidence: UTCore snapshots vehicle values once, writes absolute values, then restores that snapshot. A later external modifier has no ownership/composition channel and can be overwritten on restore.
cross_file_findings.missing_proof: Cross-mod ordering and integer coercion of setEngineFeature were not tested in Kahlua.
cross_file_findings.recommended_correction: Define ownership/composition or resnapshot only under a verified invariant; round/validate integer engine features explicitly.
cross_file_findings.smallest_regression_test: Apply external changes after UTCore entry, exit, and assert the external changes survive.

cross_file_findings.title: Additive source buckets compose speed, carry, work, and transfer modifiers deterministically
cross_file_findings.reproduction_or_source_evidence: All executable UniversalTraits callers in these families pass stable source IDs; aggregation sorts/combines bucket values and clamps movement/work/capacity paths.
cross_file_findings.missing_proof: Engine-side feel and external-mod composition remain runtime concerns, not static composition gaps.
cross_file_findings.recommended_correction: Retain the bucket contract and add explicit removal/baseline semantics.
cross_file_findings.smallest_regression_test: Apply the same bucket set in every order and assert byte-identical moddata aggregates and final values.

surface_gap_reconciliation.non_ut_core_recurring_findings_dispositi: Not re-adjudicated except where a UniversalTraits caller touched UTCore; they are outside this closed-world integration scope.

unresolved_runtime_proofs.reproduction_or_source_evidence: Base constants match current BodyPart source, but 10/30-tick correction batches use current bleedingTime and GameTime multiplier as proxies for the preceding window.
unresolved_runtime_proofs.missing_proof: No engine run across time-speed and mid-window bandage changes.
unresolved_runtime_proofs.recommended_correction: Measure native and corrected deltas across each transition; replace approximations if error exceeds design tolerance.
unresolved_runtime_proofs.smallest_regression_test: Command: & 'C:\Steam\steamapps\common\ProjectZomboid\ProjectZomboid64.exe' -debug. Scenario: fixed wound, 1x/3x speed, bandage/unbandage at ticks 5 and 15, record per-tick bleedingTime and overall health.

unresolved_runtime_proofs.title: Movement multiplier timing and receiver behavior in the live Kahlua loop
unresolved_runtime_proofs.reproduction_or_source_evidence: Static engine tests establish OnPlayerMove and next-position methods, but not every action/vehicle/collision interaction.
unresolved_runtime_proofs.missing_proof: No authorized game execution or profiler capture.
unresolved_runtime_proofs.recommended_correction: Run a deterministic movement matrix and record displacement, action state, vehicle state, and log volume.
unresolved_runtime_proofs.smallest_regression_test: Command: & 'C:\Steam\steamapps\common\ProjectZomboid\ProjectZomboid64.exe' -debug. Scenario: walk/run/sprint with +/- modifiers, timed action active, collision, vehicle enter, save/reload.

unresolved_runtime_proofs.title: Timed-action and reading monkey patches across all current action tables
unresolved_runtime_proofs.reproduction_or_source_evidence: getDuration exists and wrapper guards are present, but broad _G patch coverage, load order, third-party wrapper composition, and completion XP behavior are not live-proven.
unresolved_runtime_proofs.missing_proof: No full action matrix or Kahlua wrapper-chain execution.
unresolved_runtime_proofs.recommended_correction: Instrument representative action families and wrapper order; assert one application and exact restoration/completion.
unresolved_runtime_proofs.smallest_regression_test: Command: & 'C:\Steam\steamapps\common\ProjectZomboid\ProjectZomboid64.exe' -debug. Scenario: crafting, transfer, medical, mechanics, and skill-book completion with each trait and a second wrapper mod.

unresolved_runtime_proofs.title: Zombie collision timing, scan cost, and save/load dedupe
unresolved_runtime_proofs.reproduction_or_source_evidence: The hook scans a 3x3 square neighborhood per active update and persists per-zombie dedupe in player moddata; mock tests do not establish live identity serialization or crowded-frame cost.
unresolved_runtime_proofs.missing_proof: No live profiler or save/load collision scenario.
unresolved_runtime_proofs.recommended_correction: Profile crowded cells and verify dedupe reset/serialization and ownership transitions.
unresolved_runtime_proofs.smallest_regression_test: Command: & 'C:\Steam\steamapps\common\ProjectZomboid\ProjectZomboid64.exe' -debug. Scenario: 1/25/100 nearby zombies, stop/restart sprint, save/reload, then switch to a character without the trait.

unresolved_runtime_proofs.title: Save/load, Lua reset, and dynamic-trait lifecycle invariants
unresolved_runtime_proofs.reproduction_or_source_evidence: Static review identified caches, persistent moddata, local declaration tables, and event fences with different reset lifetimes.
unresolved_runtime_proofs.recommended_correction: Define supported lifecycle invariants, then test exact handler counts, cache ownership, and baselines after each transition.
unresolved_runtime_proofs.smallest_regression_test: Command: & 'C:\Steam\steamapps\common\ProjectZomboid\ProjectZomboid64.exe' -debug. Scenario: new game, save, reload, return to menu, load second character, ResetLua in debug, compare handler counts and moddata.
